description: This Java source file defines the RetryingBlockTransferor class, which manages retry logic for block transfer operations in Spark's network shuffle component. It wraps block fetchers or pushers to handle transient network errors with retries, ensuring reliable data transfer with guaranteed callbacks.

classes.name: RetryingBlockTransferor
classes.description: Manages retry logic for block transfer operations, wrapping fetchers or pushers to handle transient network errors with retries, ensuring guaranteed callbacks.

classes.name: RetryingBlockTransferor.BlockTransferStarter
classes.description: Interface for initiating block transfer operations, creating fetchers or pushers.

classes.name: RetryingBlockTransferor.RetryingBlockTransferListener
classes.description: Listener class that handles responses from block transfer attempts, managing success, failure, and retries.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins transfer of all blocks with retry logic for transient errors.

methods.name: transferAllOutstanding
methods.description: Initiates transfer of all remaining blocks, handling exceptions and retries.

methods.name: initiateRetry
methods.description: Starts a retry attempt in a separate thread after a wait period.

methods.name: shouldRetry
methods.description: Determines if a transfer failure warrants a retry based on exception type and retry count.

methods.name: getRetryCount
methods.description: Returns the current number of retry attempts.
